title: A segmented-breakpoint measure of cross-shore sea-surface-temperature structure in the Benguela system: code and derived data
description: Research code and derived data supporting the accepted Ocean Science article. Includes continuous segmented regression, native-pixel sampling, AR(1)-adjusted model evidence, sensitivity and bootstrap analyses, study mesh, derived tables and representative profiles. Code: MIT. Derived data and documentation: CC BY 4.0. Original SST and ERA5 NetCDF inputs are obtained separately; see docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
